review_time_definition: Wall-clock from first detailed inspection to submission; includes coordination/tool delays, not independent human labor.

anchors.quote: Conditionally encode the nonempty index domain range(col, n) and mark the unique index that Python's left-to-right max operation would select from the keys abs(rows[i][col]), including its first-index tie behavior. Grover-style search would only propose the pivot index; it would not replace elimination or solve the linear system.

Encode col, candidate indices, and the dynamically updated binary64 entries rows[i][col]. A reversible predicate must reproduce Python-compatible absolute value, comparison, equality, sequential first-tie selection, signed-zero behavior, and any behavior arising if elimination has produced a nonfinite intermediate. Coherent loading, floating-point representation, ancilla cleanup, and gate costs are unresolved.
Determining whether an index is Python's selected first maximum requires comparison with the active domain or simulation of the original scan, making each oracle evaluation potentially linear.

binding.rationale: Revision retains the same local nomination but replaces the initial concrete predicate with a requirement to reproduce Python's left-to-right selection. It gives no initialization/update rule or full alternative Boolean relation. Mentioning simulation of a scan and exact verification is not a constructed scan; do not credit disappearance of a false formula as verified repair.
